title: Analysis workflow for a whole-genome variant dataset of 234 indigenous pigs from nine breeds in Yunnan, China
description: Executable shell workflow used to produce the variant dataset described in the accompanying Scientific Data descriptor: read filtering (fastp), quality assessment (FastQC), alignment to Sscrofa11.1 (BWA-MEM2, SAMtools), duplicate removal (Sambamba), per-sample variant calling and joint genotyping (GATK HaplotypeCaller, CombineGVCFs, GenotypeGVCFs), hard filtering (GATK VariantFiltration) and population-level filtering (VCFtools), functional annotation (ANNOVAR, Ensembl release 104), and the summary scripts behind Tables 1-3 and Figures 2-4. Raw reads are deposited at NCBI SRA under PRJNA1510310; the variant call set is deposited at the European Variation Archive under PRJEB125594.
